title: Capture system setup guide screenshots
description:
Problem: the system setup guide now contains ID-based screenshot placeholders but no captured assets yet.

Desired outcome: collect and attach a complete screenshot set for `guides/system-setup` so onboarding docs are fully illustrated.

Scope:
- In scope: capture, crop/redact as needed, and place images under `Data/Pages/assets` with stable filenames mapped to placeholder IDs `SYS-SETUP-01` through `SYS-SETUP-13`.
- Out of scope: content rewrites beyond image insertion and minor caption adjustments.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every `SYS-SETUP-*` placeholder in `Data/Pages/guides/system-setup.md` has a corresponding image file and markdown image reference.
- Captured images avoid secrets/personal data and match current UI behavior.
- Guide renders with images in `/pages` without broken links.

Validation:
- Open `/pages` and verify rendered `guides/system-setup` with all images loading.
- Confirm markdown links resolve under `/page-assets`.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to track screenshot capture and insertion for all SYS-SETUP placeholders.
